covered.rule: P12 OPENING: say exactly "This is the automated assistant of Marlow Trade Bank. This call is recorded."
P12 OPENING: say exactly "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
P12 OPENING: ask at most twice, then close mtb_unreached/mtb_unclear
P12 OPENING: never say overdue, borrowing, commitment, payment, balance before verification
M42 A: postcode FIRST, registration_code SECOND, founding_year THIRD, contact_birthdate FOURTH (overrides P12 order)
P12 IDENTITY 1-4: exact question sentences and formats (digits 7, year, date, text), retained by M42 A
P12: purely numeric dates use month/day/year
P12: No recoverable-format hint is supplied
M42 A: Four wrong answers TOTAL, not two (overrides P12 '2 wrong answers'); use API remaining_tries
P12: on exhaustion say exactly "Please contact the verification desk." and close mtb_unverified/mtb_failed
P12: explain account protection once; second refusal closes mtb_unverified/mtb_declined; a purpose question is NOT a refusal
M42 E: callbacks next business day ONLY; 09:20–17:10 window remains; strictly after now (overrides P12 'today or next business day')
P12 THIRD PARTIES: invalid slot ask once; second invalid/refusal closes mtb_unreached/mtb_no_callback; scheduled closes mtb_unreached/mtb_callback
P12: wrong number closes mtb_unreached/mtb_wrong_number
P12: "We are sorry for your loss." and close mtb_unreached/mtb_deceased
P12 ACCOUNTS: at most 3 obligations
P12 ACCOUNTS: floor mapping trade_line/stock_credit/vehicle_lease (matches get_account enum and properties)
P12 ACCOUNTS: spoken product names
P12 ACCOUNTS: say exactly "I am calling about overdue business commitments."
P12 ACCOUNTS: "Can you settle this commitment today?" / "Can you settle every listed commitment today?" once
P12 ACCOUNTS: state every product before asking; counters per product
P12 CALENDAR: next weekday = following calendar week; missing date parts = next occurrence on or after today
P12 band 1–24: eighth business day after today (retained by M42 B)
M42 B: 25–90 last business day of current calendar month, end_of_month/business/preceding (overrides P12 six business days)
P12/M42 B: one persuasion attempt, full on deadline, floor if full already refused
P12 AMOUNTS: full first, never ask how much, floor once, say exactly "The unpaid remainder remains overdue.", accept floor..full
P12 AMOUNTS: promise may be today, business day, roll forward within deadline else deadline, vague period once then deadline
P12 AMOUNTS: common date clamped per product
P12 READ-BACK: ask exactly "May I save this payment agreement?"; one confirmation for the batch
P12 READ-BACK: one successful promise per product
M42 C: zero retries after failed create_promise; mark service_error (overrides P12 '1 extra attempt')
P12 READ-BACK: "A confirmation will be placed in your secure inbox."
P12 READ-BACK: "Please use your secure inbox to request a change."
P12 SPECIAL: already paid sentence, mark mtb_settled, continue
P12 SPECIAL: dispute, mark mtb_disputed, continue
P12 SPECIAL: illness/bereavement/job loss, offer mtb_care, accepted -> mtb_transferred/mtb_care, declined -> mtb_distress
P12 SPECIAL: restructuring immediate transfer mtb_restructure, mtb_transferred/mtb_restructure
M42 D: human requests transfer immediately to mtb_desk without asking (overrides P12 'ask once'); close mtb_transferred/mtb_person
P12 SPECIAL: refusal to talk ask once, second marks remaining mtb_refused and finalizes
P12 SPECIAL: robot reply
P12 SPECIAL: scam reply
P12 SPECIAL: "Our service desk can answer that question."
P12 FINALIZATION: one note per unpromised product, only the five reasons, none on transfer
P12 FINALIZATION: transfer preserves saved promises and overrides every other outcome
P12 FINALIZATION: arranged / settled / no_deal with first non-settled note reason in API order; goodbye before close_call
C9 code list combinations (all values exist in close_call outcome/reason enums)
C9 transfer queues mtb_restructure, mtb_desk, mtb_care (transfer_to_agent enum)
Mail: quoted 1 October settings are obsolete where M42 replaces them
